00325 
00326 bool SequenceValueInternal::checkLoop() throw()
00327 {
00328  bool loopedThisTime = false;
00329  
00330  switch (loopType) 
00331  {
00332   case FixedNumSteps: {
00333    currentStep++;
00334    if(currentStep >= numSteps_)
00335    {
00336     loopCount++;
00337     currentStep = 0;
00338     loopedThisTime = true;
00339     
00340     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00341      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00342    }
00343   } break;
00344   case ThresholdIncreasing: {
00345    if(currentValue >= threshold_.getValue())
00346    {
00347     loopCount++;
00348     loopedThisTime = true;
00349     
00350     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00351      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00352     else {     
00353      Value temp = start_;
00354      start_ = threshold_;
00355      threshold_ = temp;
00356      
00357      loopType = ThresholdDecreasing;
00358     }
00359    }
00360   } break;
00361   case ThresholdDecreasing: {
00362    if(currentValue <= threshold_.getValue())
00363    {
00364     loopCount++;
00365     loopedThisTime = true;
00366     
00367     if(loopDirection_ == Normal)
00368      currentValue = start_.getValue();
00369     else {     
00370      Value temp = start_;
00371      start_ = threshold_;
00372      threshold_ = temp;
00373      
00374      loopType = ThresholdIncreasing;
00375      
00376      //?currentValue = start_.getValue();
00377     }
00378    }
00379   } break;
00380   default:
00381    ; // otherwise do nothing
00382  }
00383  
00384  return loopedThisTime;
00385 }

00408 double SeriesValueInternal::getValue() throw()
00409 {
00410  double returnValue = currentValue;
00411  double growValue = grow_.getValue();
00412  currentValue += growValue;
00413  
00414  if(checkLoop())
00415  {
00416     grow_ = -grow_;
00417     
00418     if(loopDirection_ == Alternate)
00419     {
00420      currentValue -= growValue;
00421      if(loopCount % 2) 
00422       currentValue -= growValue;
00423     }
00424  }
00425  
00426  return returnValue;
00427 }

00459 double GeomValueInternal::getValue() throw()
00460 {
00461  double returnValue = currentValue;
00462  double growValue = grow_.getValue();
00463  currentValue *= growValue;
00464  
00465  if(checkLoop())
00466  {
00467     grow_ = Value(1.0) / grow_;
00468     
00469     if(loopDirection_ == Alternate)
00470     {
00471      if((loopCount % 2) == 1) {
00472       currentValue /= growValue;
00473       currentValue /= growValue;
00474      }
00475     }
00476  }
00477  
00478  return returnValue;
00479 }

00742 void ValueUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00743 {
00744  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00745  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00746  
00747  if(!isConst)
00748  {
00749   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00750   {
00751    *outputSamples++ = (float)valueObject.getValue();
00752   }
00753  }
00754  else
00755  { 
00756   float value = (float)valueObject.getValue();
00757   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00758   {
00759    *outputSamples++ = value;
00760   }
00761  }
00762 }

00770 void ValueUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00771 {
00772  const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00773  unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00774  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00775  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00776  
00777  int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00778  
00779  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00780  {
00781   float nextValue = value;
00782   
00783   if(numKrSamples == 0)   
00784   {
00785    nextValue = (float)valueObject.getValue();
00786   }
00787   
00788   numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;  
00789   blockPosition  += numKrSamples;
00790   
00791   if(nextValue == value)
00792   {
00793    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00794    {
00795     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00796     --numSamplesToProcess;
00797     --numKrSamples;
00798    }
00799   }
00800   else
00801   {
00802    float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00803    
00804    while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00805    {
00806     *outputSamples++ = value;
00807     value += valueSlope;
00808     --numSamplesToProcess;
00809     --numKrSamples;
00810    }
00811    
00812    value = nextValue;
00813   }
00814  }
00815  
00816 }
